key_facts: July 18 UPDATE (Independent Arabia July 15, Al-Modon/Nabd July 15, Aydinlik July 16/17, The National July 15, Caliber.Az July 17): Four independent Arabic, Turkish, and English reporting streams unanimously confirm President Ahmad al-Sharaa replaced Intelligence Chief Hussein al-Salama with Abdulqader al-Tahhan AND appointed Hussein al-Salama to head Syria's National Security body. Crucially, Arabic reporting resolves yesterday's Council-vs-Bureau ambiguity: Independent Arabia explicitly states Maj. Gen. Hussein Salama was appointed head of the National Security apparatus ('رئيساً لجهاز الأمن القومي'), Al-Modon reports an official announcement is imminent naming Hussein al-Salama Director of the National Security Administration ('مدير إدارة الأمن القومي'), and Aydinlik notes al-Sharaa chairs the Council while official decrees are not yet published (aligning directly with the July 19 resolution date for SANA publication). Raised Hussein al-Salama 0.78->0.88 (keeping ~12% residual since SANA decree is still unpublished as of July 18); trimmed Abdulqader al-Tahhan 0.07->0.04, Anas Khattab 0.05->0.03, Ali Keda 0.03->0.02, Murhaf Abu Qasra 0.02->0.01 (sum 0.98). Go to 0.98-0.99 immediately upon SANA decree July 19.
next_review_trigger: FINAL DAY July 19: check SANA for official presidential decree confirming Hussein al-Salama as head of Syria's National Security Bureau (update immediately to 0.98-0.99).
